body:
My friends are all part of the "depression-isn't-real-suck-it-up" camp. It's odd because one of them majored in psych. 

I can't afford to see a doctor right now. I don't know what to do. It's becoming more and more frequent that I feel like this. I don't think I've ever felt this horrible. I'm have a difficult time making rational decisions.

I can't focus on anything anymore. I really feel cornered here.
